nodes.name: doc.vue
nodes.summary: SelectDoc playground that demos g-select variants: size, status, search, grouping, custom fieldNames, multiple/tags mode, maxTagCount, events, and combined props.
nodes.languageNotes: Vue 3 <script setup> SFC registered as SelectDoc; live demos bind many refs to g-select and DocSection.

nodes.name: useColorMode.ts
nodes.summary: Shared Vue composable that persists light/dark/system color mode, toggles the html.dark class, and follows prefers-color-scheme when mode is system.
nodes.languageNotes: Module-level refs keep every caller in sync; pair with the index.html inline script to avoid FOUC.

nodes.name: useColorMode
nodes.summary: Returns shared mode, resolved scheme, isDark, setMode, toggle, and COLOR_MODES for UI color-mode controls.

nodes.name: useRipple.ts
nodes.summary: Material-style ripple composable that injects a currentColor span on pointerdown and animates it with the Web Animations API.
nodes.languageNotes: Ripple uses currentColor so it follows theme and variant without extra wiring; host must be position:relative and overflow:hidden.

nodes.name: useRipple
nodes.summary: Creates a trigger handler that draws a clipped ripple from the pointer, skips disabled hosts, and cancels leftover animations on unmount.

nodes.name: useThemeColor.ts
nodes.summary: Shared Vue composable that persists the primary theme color, writes html data-theme-color, and exposes THEME_COLORS for the picker.
nodes.languageNotes: data-theme-color values map to Radix step-10 rules in style.css; module-level ref keeps callers in sync.

nodes.name: readInitialThemeColor
nodes.summary: Resolves the initial theme color from localStorage, then the html data-theme-color attribute, then DEFAULT_THEME_COLOR.

nodes.name: useThemeColor
nodes.summary: Returns the shared themeColor computed, setThemeColor, and THEME_COLORS list for theme-color pickers.

nodes.name: doc.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel that re-exports UI documentation SFCs: OverviewDoc, ButtonDoc, IconDoc, InputDoc, and SelectDoc.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript barrel re-exporting Vue SFC default exports as named doc components.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Exports cn, which merges clsx class values through tailwind-merge so Tailwind utilities can be composed without conflicts.

nodes.name: cn
nodes.summary: Merges class name inputs with clsx then tailwind-merge for conflict-safe Tailwind class composition.

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: UI package design-token stylesheet: Tailwind v4 theme mapping, light/dark oklch tokens, Radix color scales, and data-theme-color primary presets.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind v4 @theme inline maps --gritty-design-* tokens; [data-theme-color] rules override primary after .dark so attribute specificity wins.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite config for the UI package enabling Vue SFCs, Tailwind, and an @ alias to ./src.
